messages:
devon: Quick update folks — small schedule change for the upcoming annual attestation window. New window: Mon 2026-05-11 -> Fri 2026-05-15. We pushed one week to accommodate product launch. Please plan accordingly. :calendar:

anya: Thanks for the heads-up. Does this affect the SOC2 evidence sweep too or just privacy attestations?

sylvia: We have several managers who asked for the extra week, so this helps.

devon: Mainly privacy attestation & manager sign-offs. SOC2 control-owner sweep remains the week of Apr 27 (unchanged). We'll post a combined calendar invite for the new dates.

trey: For folks in release/oncall that week, can managers delegate signing? I have two folks on rotation.

anya: Delegation is fine — use the "delegate" field in the form and include the delegate's name + short note. Keeps the audit trail intact.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled — DM to managers on 2026-05-11T09:00Z.

sylvia: Are contractors included again? We've had confusion there before.

devon: Yes contractors in Okta/headcount are included. If a contractor shouldn't be counted, mark "exclude" and add a short justification in the form. Security will review exclusions.

anya: Artifact guidance: screenshot of LMS cert or a one-line CSV row per person (name, training, completion date) is acceptable. Keep it lightweight.

trey: I'll assemble a CSV and delegate signing for my oncall folks. ETA Tue EOD.

devon: Great. If managers need an extension, put "exception request" in the form with ETA and reason — we'll triage requests daily.

compliance-bot: Auto follow-up scheduled for 2026-05-14T16:00Z for outstanding attestations.

anya: Posting a short FAQ + form link in #people-ops and in the calendar invite. Thanks all — appreciate the quick pivots around launch. :rocket:
